title: 第25章 过于招人喜欢第26章 言传身教
content_zh:
;;
荡邪行动，这是长春宫近年来针对周边地区的乱象组织优秀弟子展开的一场大规模长期集体任务。
此前枫林子经常出门在外，就是在执行这个任务。
原本枫林子这次回来是要休息一下的，但是因为苏白尘也要去，他就干脆放弃休息，匆匆跟着一起出来了。
对此苏白尘是非常感谢的，他知道这是枫林子担心他的安危特意如此。
“东西都准备好了吗？”
出发前，苏白尘向师父告辞的时候，玄阴真人也是忍不住多问了一句。
苏白尘点头道：“师父，东西我都已经领好了，师兄还特意给我准备了三支穿云箭。”
枫林子颔首：“师父，我会在仙游县中驻守，而师弟则是在家乡所属的河口镇，这样他能照料家乡，而我也能及时照看师弟。”
玄阴真人点头道：“这些事情你来安排我还是能够放心的，只是白尘你刚刚完成筑基，可不能在这种事务上耗费太多心神啊……”
苏白尘道：“师父请放心，弟子也就是闲来看护一下家乡，正经的修行是一丁点也不敢忘记的。”
枫林子笑了一下帮腔：“师父也莫要太过担心了，这不过是一些散修或者根本就是一些普通人得到了那左道之法，他们不懂修行界的规矩，也不知道我长春宫的威势……等过阵子我们重新立威，他们也就知道了。”
玄阴真人却肃然提醒：“莫要疏忽大意，幕后之人制造了此等乱局必然是有所图谋，要小心谨慎啊。”
枫林子颔首：“那是自然，弟子一切都小心着呢。”
玄阴真人又看向苏白尘：“白尘，你的修为尚浅，一切以谨慎为先，若要与人争斗一定要妥善使用你的‘幻阴八变’，明白了吗？”
苏白尘也连忙应了。
他的幻阴八变已经到了四品，在实战中已经有极强的表现了。
而玄阴真人明知道苏白尘本质上是个剑修，还让他以幻术应敌……这是一丁点都不想看到小徒弟冒险啊。
苏白尘认认真真地应了一声是，表示自己肯定不会莽的，一定记得师父的教诲云云……好一会儿，才被放了出来。
这些年苏白尘早就知道自己这师父是个外冷内热的人……也是，若非如此也教不出枫林子这样的徒弟吧。

阴风关的通天梯，这里苏白尘很熟悉，他每日都会在这楼梯井中练剑。
而这一次，则是他要从这里上去了。
枫林子看了看苏白尘问：“提气纵身的法门练得怎么样？”
苏白尘答：“我练了‘腾云飞纵术’，还算可以吧。”
“好，那你跟上我！”
说着，枫林子就已经纵身而起直线向上飞纵而去。
苏白尘看着枫林子这般一下跃起有二十多米高，中间轻巧地在楼梯上借力一下就能继续向上，看起来轻盈极了。
他连忙也提起真气飞纵而起。
这‘腾云飞纵术’是长春宫内弟子都可以学的‘普通’轻身术，练到高深处，那是可以直接踏云飞翔的。
而苏白尘此时固然做不到像枫林子那样一跃就二十多米高，但他一跃十多米也是没问题的。
十多米高度，那就是每隔两个楼梯平台就要借力一次。
虽然在轻巧方面比枫林子差了不少，但频繁换气借力之下速度上倒是没慢多少。
枫林子在踏上这通天梯顶层之后不过两三息的时间，苏白尘也就从下面腾身而起落在了旁边。
content_en:
;;
Action to eliminate evil is a large-scale and long-term collective mission carried out by outstanding disciples organized by Changchun Palace in recent years to target chaos in surrounding areas.
Previously, Feng Linzi often went out to perform this task.
Originally, Feng Linzi wanted to take a rest when he came back this time, but because Su Baichen was also going, he simply gave up on rest and hurriedly followed him out.
Su Baichen was very grateful for this. He knew that Feng Linzi was worried about his safety.
"Is everything ready?"
Before departure, when Su Baichen said goodbye to his master, Master Xuanyin couldn't help but ask one more question.
Su Baichen nodded and said: "Master, I have collected everything. My senior brother also specially prepared three cloud-piercing arrows for me."
Feng Linzi nodded: "Master, I will be stationed in Xianyou County, while my junior brother will be in Hekou Town where his hometown belongs, so that he can take care of his hometown and I can take care of my junior brother in time."
Master Xuanyin nodded and said: "I can rest assured that you will arrange these things, but Bai Chen, you have just completed foundation building, so you can't spend too much energy on such matters..."
Su Baichen said: "Master, please don't worry. This disciple is just here to take care of his hometown. He dares not forget the slightest bit of serious practice."
Feng Linzi smiled and helped: "Master, don't worry too much. These are just some casual cultivators or ordinary people who have obtained the heretical method. They don't understand the rules of the cultivation world, and they don't know the power of my Changchun Palace... They will know after a while when we re-establish our authority."
Master Xuanyin reminded solemnly: "Don't be careless. The people behind the scenes must have some agenda to create such chaos, so be careful."
Feng Linzi nodded: "That's natural. Disciples are careful about everything."
Master Xuanyin looked at Su Baichen again: "Baichen, your cultivation level is still shallow, so you should put caution first. If you want to fight with others, you must use your 'Eight Transformations of Fantasy Yin' properly. Do you understand?"
Su Baichen also quickly agreed.
His Eight Transformations of Huan Yin has reached the fourth level, and his performance has been extremely strong in actual combat.
And Master Xuanyin knew that Su Baichen was essentially a sword cultivator, yet still asked him to use illusions to deal with the enemy... This was because he didn't want to see his young apprentice take any risks.
Su Baichen said yes seriously, saying that he would definitely not be reckless and must remember the master's teachings... After a while, he was released.
Over the years, Su Baichen had long known that his master was a person who was cold on the outside and hot on the inside... Also, if not for this, he wouldn't be able to teach a disciple like Feng Linzi.
Su Baichen is very familiar with the Stairway to Heaven in Yinfeng Pass. He practices his sword in this stairwell every day.
But this time, he was going up from here.
Feng Linzi looked at Su Baichen and asked, "How are you practicing the technique of raising your energy and jumping up?"
Su Baichen replied: "I have practiced the 'Soaring Cloud Flying Technique', and it's pretty good."
"Okay, then follow me!"
With that said, Feng Linzi jumped up and flew straight upward.
Su Baichen watched Feng Linzi jump up to more than 20 meters in height, and he could continue upward by using some force on the stairs. It looked extremely light.
He quickly raised his zhenqi and flew up.
This 'Soaring Cloud Flying Technique' is an 'ordinary' light body technique that all disciples in the Changchun Palace can learn. If you practice it to a high level, you can fly directly on the clouds.
Although Su Baichen couldn't jump more than twenty meters high like Feng Linzi at this time, he could jump more than ten meters in one jump.
At a height of more than ten meters, that means you need to use force every two stair landings.
Although it is much inferior to Feng Linzi in terms of lightness, the speed is not much slower due to the frequent ventilation.
Only two or three breaths after Feng Linzi stepped onto the top of the ladder to the sky, Su Baichen rose from below and landed next to him.
